description: Form-associated star rating web component: generates a fieldset[data-rating] of radios (CSS layer) opted into the rating effect (clear, rating:change), and submits one name=value entry via ElementInternals.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. FormData gets exactly one name=value entry via ElementInternals; omit for read-only.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Rating value, also the form-reset default (default: 0). Observed: changing it after upgrade updates the rating.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Number of stars (default: 5). Observed: changing it rebuilds the stars, keeping the value.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Display-only mode (role="img" summary, partial stars). Observed.

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Lucide icon name for icon-wc (default: star text)

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Makes rating required for form validation (valueMissing until a star is chosen). Observed.

attributes.name: data-label-one
attributes.description: Radio label for the Intl.PluralRules "one" category; {n} is the Intl.NumberFormat value (default "{n} star"). Any CLDR category works (data-label-few, ...). Locale from the closest [lang].

attributes.name: data-label-other
attributes.description: Radio label for categories without their own data-label-* (default "{n} stars")

attributes.name: data-label-readonly
attributes.description: Read-only summary; {label}, {value}, {max} are replaced (default "{label}: {value} out of {max}")

attributes.name: data-label-required
attributes.description: Validation message when required and empty (default "Please select a rating")

attributes.name: data-label-cleared
attributes.description: Live-region announcement when the rating is cleared (default "Rating cleared")

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current rating (0 = none). Settable before connect; applied when the stars are built.

events.name: rating:change
events.description: Fires (bubbling, from the inner fieldset) when the rating changes, including clear to 0. detail: { value: number }

childAttributes.name: data-effect
childAttributes.description: Generated: "rating" opts the fieldset into the rating effect

childAttributes.name: data-half
childAttributes.description: Generated with allow-half: which half of the star the label covers

cssProperties.name: --rating-color
cssProperties.description: Filled star colour (default var(--color-warning)); set on star-rating or any [data-rating]
